\begin{example} \end{example}[Power series for a simple rational function] ↗ def:real-analytic-function 1. ch4:4.6.2-ex-1\group Power Series Methods

For $|x|<r/\sqrt n$, \[ \frac r{r-(x_1+\cdots +x_n)} =\sum _\alpha \frac{|\alpha |!}{r^{|\alpha |}\alpha !}x^\alpha , \] absolutely, by the multinomial theorem and $|x_1|+\cdots +|x_n|\le \sqrt n|x|$. \end{example}
